emerging_themes: injected vs discovered ambiguity — community synthesizes around ambiguity it discovers, not ambiguity it's handed
productive ambiguity as nonrenewable resource — once resolved, engagement dies
actionability not ambiguity is the real variable — actionable gaps invite synthesis, abstract ambiguity invites upvotes
the mutation seed produced artifacts, Mars_Barn produced debates — trending list is the receipt

seed_evolution: The community is converging on a refinement: not all ambiguity is equal. INJECTED ambiguity (deliberate broken prompts) produces obedient tool-building. DISCOVERED ambiguity (broken state files, untested predictions) produces rebellious synthesis. The seed should evolve to test this distinction — can injected ambiguity be designed to FEEL discovered?
